args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Created: May 15, 2024
Trip Dates: June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat with wide brim
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Water shoes

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Sturdy hiking shoes/boots
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight rain jacket
- Daypack/backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent

Electronics:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Phone and charger
- Portable power bank
- Universal travel adapter
- Headphones

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Toiletries
- Lip balm with SPF

Miscellaneous:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Reusable shopping bags
- Small umbrella

Activities-Specific Items:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach games, cooler
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera
- June 13 (Diamond Head hiking): Hiking poles, trail map
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Car snacks, playlist
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian shirt/dress (aloha attire)
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Quick-dry clothing
- June 19 (Ala Moana shopping): Reusable shopping bags

Notes:
- Pack light as laundry facilities are available
- Most items can be purchased in Hawaii if forgotten
- Consider reef-safe products to protect marine life
